lead.headline: Sadiq is still a Sunday-morning call; the flex is still a point off
lead.deck: Your only tight end was limited all week and nothing changed overnight. Andrews is free and has no game status. Downs still belongs in the flex, and Keenan Allen missing Friday's practice leans the same way.
lead.body: Kenyon Sadiq's status did not move overnight. The Jets' own report has him limited on Wednesday, Thursday and Friday with the back he hurt on a diving touchdown catch, and questionable; no coach has said which way it leans. He is the only tight end on this roster and no bench player can cover the slot, so the plan stays on the wire: if he is inactive at 09:30 tomorrow, add Mark Andrews, a free agent with no game status, and drop Carnell Tate. The flex is undone for a fifth edition. Bhayshul Tuten is in it, ESPN prefers Josh Downs by a point, and a coin flip goes to the projection. One correction to last night's paper strengthens that: Keenan Allen did not practise on Friday, where it said limited, and his groin is reported to have gone the wrong way. If Allen sits, Downs' share grows, and the 13.7 does not know it. Downs locks at 07:30 tomorrow in London. The Ravens D/ST hold at 7.0 without Trey Hendrickson, a point below the free Bills, on a seat that changed hands Wednesday. Team 13 still start DeVonta Smith and Rachaad White, both ruled out, which is why ESPN has you at 68%. That number shrinks the moment they set a lineup.
